name: create-sunder-package
description: Scaffold runtime-backed Sunder Node Worker packages and combined React App packages.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js
